items.title: サッカー＝フランスはイタリアと引き分け、ジダン監督のホーム初陣
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２日　ロイター］ - サッカーの欧州ネーションズリーグ（ＮＬ）は２日、各地で１次リーグの試合を行い、リーグＡの１組ではフランスがホームでイタリアに１─１で引き分けた。

フランスは０─０で迎えた後半１０分、ゴール右寄りの位置でＦＫを得ると、少し動かしたボールをミカエル・オリーズが左足でシュートし、ネットを揺らした。しかし、同２３分に自陣でのボールロストからアレッサンドロ・バストーニに同点弾を許すと、同４０分にはダヨ・ウパメカノが２枚目のイエローカードを受けて退場した。

フランス指揮官就任後のホーム初戦をドローで終えたジネディーヌ・ジダン監督は、ＴＦ１で「選手たちのことを思うと非常に残念だ。われわれはもっと良い結果に値するプレーを見せていた。選手たちを誇りに思う。ハードワークやプレッシングは、まさに模範的だった」と振り返った。

同組のもう１試合では、ベルギーがホームでトルコと対戦。ケビン・デブルイネの２得点とロメル・ルカクのゴールにより、３─０で快勝した。

この結果、１組は３試合を終えて勝ち点７のフランスが首位。ベルギーは勝ち点６の２位で、イタリアは勝ち点４の３位。勝ち点０のトルコは最下位となっている。

items.title: Ｆ１＝バーレーンＧＰフリー走行、フェルスタッペンが最速
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［セパン（マレーシア）　２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［セパン（マレーシア）　２日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１のバーレーン・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は２日、マレーシアのセパンでフリー走行を行い、レッドブルのマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ）がこの日のトップタイムを記録した。

中東情勢を受けてマレーシアで開催されている今大会、フェルスタッペンはフリー走行１回目に１分３７秒５２０をマークした。２回目でトップだったフェラーリのシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ）が１分３７秒５２８で続き、その差はわずか０秒００８だった。

３番手は２回目に１分３７秒６２７を記録したレッドブルのアイザック・ハジャー（フランス）。昨季王者でマクラーレンのランド・ノリス（英国）が２回目に１分３７秒６６５で４番手だった。

個人総合首位のキミ・アントネッリ（メルセデス、イタリア）は２回目の１分３８秒０６０が自己ベストで８番手だった。

items.title: サッカー＝久保建英選手が結婚、俳優の福原遥さんと
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部、レアル・ソシエダードに所属する日本代表ＭＦ久保建英選手が、俳優の福原遥さんと結婚したことを発表した。

両者は２日、それぞれのインスタグラムでツーショットの写真を披露し、「久保建英と福原遥は結婚致しましたことをご報告させていただきます。お互い、幼い頃からたくさんの方の支えがあって今があります。まだまだ未熟な私たちですが、皆様への感謝の気持ちを忘れることなく、共に助け合い、笑顔あふれる温かい家庭を築いていきたいと思っております」とコメントした。

２００１年生まれの久保選手は１１年にスペインの名門バルセロナの下部組織に加入。その後、ＦＣ東京で下部組織を経てトップチームデビューを飾るなどし、１９年にバルセロナの宿敵であるレアル・マドリードに移籍した。

スペインではマジョルカ、ビリャレアル、ヘタフェでもプレーした後、２２年に現在も所属するソシエダードに移籍。日本代表では１９年に１８歳でデビューを飾り、２２年と２６年のワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）に出場している。

items.title: Trump descarta prohibir las exportaciones de diésel de EE.UU. tras liberación de reservas del G7
items.author: Jennifer Dlouhy
items.summary: El bloque, que incluye a las principales economías de Europa, Norteamérica y Asia, acordó liberar el viernes hasta 100 millones de barriles de reservas de emergencia de petróleo y gasóleo, tras una in ...
items.body: Bloomberg — El presidente Donald Trump afirmó que no prohibirá las exportaciones de diésel estadounidense, después de que los países del Grupo de los Siete y sus socios acordaran liberar parte de sus reservas de combustible de emergencia en un intento por reducir los precios disparados. “Europa tiene mucho diésel y va a hacer una importante contribución mundial, al igual que nosotros”, dijo Trump a los periodistas el viernes en la Casa Blanca. “Y no vamos a imponer la prohibición de exportaciones”. Ver más: G7 liberará hasta 100 millones de barriles de petróleo y diésel ante el alza de precios El bloque, que incluye a las principales economías de Europa, Norteamérica y Asia, acordó liberar el viernes hasta 100 millones de barriles de reservas de emergencia de petróleo y gasóleo, tras una intensa campaña de presión por parte de la Administración Trump. “Les pregunté, y vamos a tener mucho petróleo”, añadió Trump. “Hicieron un gran trabajo”. La declaración de Trump se produce en medio de una subida récord de los precios del gasóleo, que alimenta gran parte de la economía moderna, hace funcionar la maquinaria agrícola, impulsa el transporte marítimo estadounidense y suministra calefacción y electricidad a las comunidades rurales. El papel fundamental del gasóleo como elemento vital del transporte marítimo y el comercio hace que el aumento de los precios haya tenido un efecto dominó en la economía, provocando un incremento de los costos de una amplia gama de bienes de consumo de cara a las elecciones de mitad de legislatura de noviembre. La decisión del presidente supone un retroceso respecto a su anterior consideración de posibles restricciones a la exportación de gasóleo, así como un desaire a los republicanos de las zonas rurales y del Medio Oeste, cuya posición se ve amenazada, que habían solicitado esas restricciones para reducir los precios del combustible, que suponen una pesada carga para los votantes antes de las elecciones. Trump afirmó el viernes que la prohibición de exportar diésel nunca fue una opción seria. “Nunca íbamos a hacerlo”, dijo a los periodistas. “No creo que lo estuviéramos considerando”. El mes pasado, el presidente dijo que había animado a sus asesores a que lo apoyaran. Ver más: ¿Por qué América Latina sentiría más el impacto de la posible prohibición de exportaciones de diésel de EE.UU.? El enfoque actual de Trump también representa un intento de encontrar el equilibrio entre dos grupos de votantes clave: las comunidades agrícolas del corazón del país, donde algunos candidatos republicanos en el cargo se enfrentan a reñidas contiendas, y los intereses petroleros que se han beneficiado del apoyo del presidente a los combustibles fósiles. En las últimas semanas, varios republicanos destacados, entre ellos los senadores Chuck Grassley, de Iowa, y Dan Sullivan, de Alaska —quien se enfrenta a una reñida contienda por la reelección—, habían instado a que se impusieran restricciones a las exportaciones. Sin embargo, los líderes de la industria petrolera y los expertos en energía advirtieron de que limitar las ventas de gasóleo al extranjero solo proporcionaría, como mucho, un alivio de los precios a corto plazo, seguido de un rápido repunte de los costos, ya que el aumento de las existencias nacionales llevaría a los productores y refinadores de petróleo estadounidenses a recortar la producción. Algunos responsables del Gobierno, entre ellos el secretario de Energía, Chris Wright, y el secretario del Interior, Doug Burgum, se han hecho eco de esas preocupaciones a nivel interno. Los costos del combustible y otros bienes de consumo figuran entre las principales quejas de los votantes de cara a las elecciones de mitad de legislatura. El gasóleo, en particular, se ha disparado debido a que las guerras en Rusia y Medio Oriente han paralizado las actividades de refino y perturbado el transporte de energía. Según la asociación automovilística AAA, el precio medio de venta al público del diésel en Estados Unidos era de US$6,37 por galón hasta el viernes. Se prevé que la liberación de reservas de petróleo anunciada el viernes y coordinada por la Agencia Internacional de la Energía ofrezca únicamente un alivio a corto plazo. Las reservas se liberarán a lo largo de los próximos cuatro meses, centrándose inicialmente en el gasóleo, según declaró el viernes el presidente francés, Emmanuel Macron. Ver más: Gasolineras en México suspenden venta de diésel para evitar pérdidas Europa depende en gran medida de las exportaciones de gasóleo de EE.UU., y la liberación de las reservas se consideró un intento de evitar una prohibición estadounidense de las ventas de combustible al extranjero. Los países del G7 han reafirmado ahora su compromiso de “abstenerse de imponer restricciones a la exportación de energía y productos energéticos” entre los países miembros. En Estados Unidos, los ejecutivos petroleros han estado suplicando a los funcionarios de la administración Trump que consideren otras opciones, advirtiendo que incluso las restricciones a las exportaciones a corto plazo provocarían recortes en la producción nacional y perjudicarían a los aliados de Estados Unidos en Europa y América Latina. Según una de las propuestas que se están considerando seriamente, la administración Trump eliminaría las restricciones a la venta de diésel rojo o teñido, que generalmente se utiliza fuera de carretera y está exento de impuestos. Esta estrategia permitiría a los minoristas vender diésel teñido, que está exento del impuesto especial federal de 24 centavos por galón, para su uso en camiones y otros vehículos de carretera. --Con la colaboración de Skylar Woodhouse, Kate Sullivan y Hadriana Lowenkron. items.title: Ataque israelense mata quatro pessoas em Gaza, dizem equipes médicas
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Um ataque aéreo israelense matou pelo menos quatro palestinos em um prédio de apartamentos na Cidade de Gaza na madrugada de sábado (horário local), informaram autoridades de saúde do território.
items.body:
Um ataque aéreo israelense matou pelo menos quatro palestinos em um prédio de apartamentos na Cidade de Gaza na madrugada de sábado (horário local), informaram autoridades de saúde do território.
Não houve comentário imediato por parte das Forças Armadas israelenses.
Os EUA mediaram um cessar-fogo no território no ano passado, mas os negociadores ainda não chegaram a um acordo sobre os termos para o desarmamento do Hamas e a retirada das tropas israelenses.
Israel, que afirma que o Hamas vem se rearmando e lançando ataques em violação ao cessar-fogo de outubro, intensificou os ataques contra o grupo nas últimas semanas.
O Hamas negou estar tentando realizar ataques ou reconstruir seu arsenal e acusa Israel de minar o acordo de paz de Gaza.
Autoridades de saúde de Gaza afirmaram que pelo menos 1.400 palestinos foram mortos por disparos israelenses desde o cessar-fogo de outubro passado. Israel afirma que quatro de seus soldados foram mortos por militantes em Gaza no mesmo período.

items.title: Latvians vote in election in shadow of drone incursions and war in Ukraine
items.author: Andrius Sytas
items.creator: Andrius Sytas
items.summary: Latvians vote in a parliamentary election on Saturday that is likely to keep power in the hands of pro-Ukrainian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs, although deep political fragmentation may complicate the formation of a government.
items.body:
Latvians vote in a parliamentary election on Saturday that is likely to keep power in the hands of pro-Ukrainian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs, although deep political fragmentation may complicate the formation of a government.
Across the Baltics, including in NATO and European Union member Latvia, many voters are on edge after official warnings of potential Russia aggression and a growing number of airspace incursions related to Moscow's war in Ukraine.
Russia says accusations that it is planning to attack NATO are baseless and Western officials say it is not capable of launching a direct assault, but security concerns have weighed heavily in the election campaign.
[USN:L8N45L1R2 TEXT:"Opinion polls"] put Kulbergs' centrist United List ahead, with about 14% of votes, but followed closely by the overtly pro-Russian Sovereign Power.
A businessman and amateur rally driver, Kulbergs, 47, came to power in May after the previous coalition crumbled over its handling of incidents in which [USN:L1N41K03T TEXT:"stray military drones flew"] undetected into Latvia. Though the drones were Ukrainian, officials [USN:L8N41X1AC TEXT:"have blamed Russia"] for causing them to divert from their flight paths.
"We have to give Ukraine everything necessary right now (so) that they can have the upper hand and win", Kulbergs told Reuters in an interview last month.
Throughout his campaign, he has also promised more anti-drone capabilities for Latvia and to maintain defence spending at 5% of gross domestic product, one of the highest levels in NATO.
But his pro-Kremlin rivals say Latvia should stop any aid to Ukraine and should instead focus more on cost-of-living issues, particularly among his country's Russian-speaking minority.
"Our voters want peace, to stop looking for shelters, to no longer experience the air alerts", party leader Julia Stepanenko told Reuters. "The war must not be encouraged in any way, including by financing it... Ukraine must win, but through peace talks".
Polls open at 8 a.m. (0500 GMT) on Saturday and close at 8 p.m., with the first results expected within hours and the final result likely to be clear after midnight. The 100 members of the Saeima, or parliament, are being elected for a four-year term.
DIVIDED NATION Surveys show at least two other parties may make it into parliament - the populist, MAGA-style Latvia First grouping and the Progressives, a left-leaning party that attracts younger voters.
Kulbergs' ability to forge a working coalition will depend largely on how many votes they receive and how many other parties cross the 5% threshhold to enter parliament.
He might also need to cobble together a deal with Latvia First leader, businessman Ainars Slesers, who appears to have shifted towards a more anti-Ukraine stance in recent months, courting votes on both sides.
"His message is that (the party) condemns Russia's invasion and stands with Ukraine, but that supporting Ukraine comes at the expense of Latvia's economy," said Roberts Kits, researcher for the Latvian Strategy and Economic Research Institute, in a note.
Latvia, with a population of 1.9 million, is sandwiched between the Baltic Sea, with EU and NATO allies Estonia and Lithuania to the north and south, and Russia and Belarus to the east.

items.title: アジア大会＝サッカー日本女子代表、北朝鮮下し3連覇
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２日　ロイター］ - 愛知・名古屋アジア大会は２日、サッカー女子決勝を行い、日本が北朝鮮との２─２からのＰＫ戦を５─３で制し、３大会連続最多４度目の優勝を果たした。

日本は前半３２分に上野真実が右足の鋭いシュートをゴール左に決めて先制。しかし、後半２分に追いつかれると、同２４分には逆転を許した。

それでも、同４１分に途中出場の西尾葉音が同点弾をマークし、延長戦へ。ＰＫ戦までもつれ込むと、北朝鮮の３人目のシュートをＧＫ大場朱羽がセーブ。日本は５人全員がＰＫを成功させた。

items.title: Hammack, do Fed, diz à PBS que ainda há tempo para avaliar próximo passo na política monetária
items.author: Michael Derby
items.creator: Michael Derby
items.summary: A presidente do Federal Reserve de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que o relatório de emprego dos EUA de setembro está em linha com a tendência recente de contratações, observando que ela ainda tem tempo antes de precisar tomar uma decisão sobre os próximos passos da política monetária.
items.body:
A presidente do Federal Reserve de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que o relatório de emprego dos EUA de setembro está em linha com a tendência recente de contratações, observando que ela ainda tem tempo antes de precisar tomar uma decisão sobre os próximos passos da política monetária.
O relatório de empregos de setembro, que mostrou um aumento aparentemente fraco de 29 mil novos empregos e uma alta na taxa de desemprego para 4,2%, está em linha com o desempenho recente do setor, disse Hammack em entrevista ao programa PBS News Hour.
“Em média, o que observamos nos últimos 12 meses foi a criação de 41.000 novos empregos por mês. Isso está amplamente alinhado com minha estimativa do ponto de equilíbrio” para o setor, o que, por sua vez, sugere uma tendência de estabilidade no mercado de trabalho, disse Hammack.
Quanto à forma como o Fed deveria reagir com a política monetária, Hammack disse: “Ainda teremos muitas informações antes de nossa reunião no final do mês e, portanto, há muito tempo para tomar uma decisão sobre qual é a postura correta da política para garantir que estejamos cumprindo ambos os aspectos de nosso mandato.”
Hammack tem sido uma defensora firme e precoce do aumento das taxas para reduzir as pressões inflacionárias que ela e seus pares do banco central consideram excessivas. Nesta semana, várias autoridades importantes do Fed afirmaram que o Fed tem tempo para avaliar os dados antes de aumentar as taxas novamente.
No mês passado, o Fed elevou sua meta de taxa de juros em um quarto de ponto percentual, para uma faixa entre 3,75% e 4%, enquanto as autoridades sinalizavam a expectativa de outro aumento antes do final do ano. Os comentários das autoridades nesta semana indicaram que não é provável que haja qualquer ação sobre as taxas na reunião do Comitê Federal de Mercado Aberto (Fomc) marcada para 27 e 28 de outubro.

items.title: Israeli strike kills five in Gaza, health officials say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: An Israeli airstrike killed at least five Palestinians in an apartment building in Gaza City early on Saturday, health and civil defense service officials said.
items.body:
An Israeli airstrike killed at least five Palestinians in an apartment building in Gaza City early on Saturday, health and civil defense service officials said.
There was no immediate comment from the Israeli military.
The US brokered a ceasefire in the territory last year but negotiators have not agreed on terms for Hamas to disarm and for Israel to withdraw its troops.
Israel, which says Hamas has been rearming and launching attacks in violation of an October ceasefire, has stepped up strikes on the group in recent weeks.
Hamas has denied trying to carry out attacks or rebuild its arsenal and accuses Israel of undermining the Gaza peace deal.
Gaza health officials have said at least 1,400 Palestinians have been killed by Israeli fire since last October's ceasefire. Israel says four of its soldiers have been killed by militants in Gaza over the same period.

items.title: Alguns países do G20 rejeitam posição dos EUA sobre excesso de capacidade industrial
items.author: David Lawder
items.creator: David Lawder
items.summary: Um “punhado” de ministros do Comércio do G20 rejeitou os apelos dos EUA para conter o excesso de capacidade industrial e as políticas não orientadas pelo mercado, informou nesta sexta-feira o gabinete do Representante de Comércio dos EUA (USTR), revelando divisões dentro do grupo das principais economias do mundo.
items.body:
Um “punhado” de ministros do Comércio do G20 rejeitou os apelos dos EUA para conter o excesso de capacidade industrial e as políticas não orientadas pelo mercado, informou nesta sexta-feira o gabinete do Representante de Comércio dos EUA (USTR), revelando divisões dentro do grupo das principais economias do mundo.
A declaração da presidência norte-americana do G20, divulgada um dia após o encerramento de uma reunião sobre comércio em Milwaukee, também revelou que apenas dois países — México e Argentina — aderiram a uma declaração liderada pelos EUA que pede mais esforços e cooperação para eliminar das cadeias de abastecimento produtos fabricados com trabalho forçado.
A rejeição ocorre após a imposição, pelo governo Trump, de tarifas de 10% ou 12,5% sobre produtos provenientes de 59 países e da União Europeia, sob a alegação de que eles não aplicam adequadamente as proibições ao trabalho forçado.
A declaração do USTR não citou os países que se opuseram à declaração sobre o excesso de capacidade. Mas a China já havia se oposto a uma declaração semelhante do G20 que denunciava o trabalho forçado e políticas econômicas não orientadas pelo mercado que levam a exportações excessivas, em uma reunião de líderes financeiros realizada há um mês em Asheville, na Carolina do Norte.
“O rascunho da declaração ministerial foi apoiado por todos, exceto por um punhado de membros, alguns dos quais rejeitaram firmemente a criação desse caminho para uma ação cooperativa” sobre o excesso de capacidade, afirmou o comunicado, acrescentando que isso “decepcionou profundamente” a presidência dos EUA no G20.
O excesso de capacidade industrial da China e os subsídios industriais têm sido temas centrais das reuniões ministeriais do G20 lideradas pelos EUA neste ano. Pequim rejeitou as alegações de que suas políticas industriais tenham criado excesso de capacidade e acusa os países ocidentais de usar a questão para justificar medidas protecionistas.
Os EUA afirmaram que os ministros do Comércio do G20 conseguiram chegar a um consenso ao condenar a instrumentalização do comércio de alimentos, com os membros concordando “que o comércio de alimentos e produtos agrícolas não deve ser usado como ferramenta de coerção econômica ou política”.

items.title: Fed's Hammack tells PBS there's still time to weigh next monetary policy move
items.author: Michael Derby
items.creator: Michael Derby
items.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said on Friday that the September US employment report fits with the recent trend of hiring, noting she has time before she has to make a decision on what is next for monetary policy.
items.body:
Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said on Friday that the September US employment report fits with the recent trend of hiring, noting she has time before she has to make a decision on what is next for monetary policy.
The September jobs report, which showed a [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"seemingly weak"] 29,000 hiring gain and a move up in the unemployment rate to 4.2%, fits in with the recent performance of the sector, Hammack said in an interview with the PBS News Hour program.
“On average, what we've seen over the past 12 months is 41,000 new jobs being created each month. That's largely in line with my estimate of what the break-even is” for the sector, which in turn suggests a trend of stability for the hiring sector, Hammack said.
Regarding how the Fed should react with monetary policy, Hammack said, “We'll still have a lot of information before our meeting at the end of the month, and so there's a lot of time to make a decision about what the right stance of policy is to make sure we're delivering on both sides of our mandate.”
Hammack has been a steadfast and early supporter of raising rates to lower inflation pressures that she and her central bank colleagues consider too high. This week, a number of key Fed officials said the Fed [USN:S0N44V01O TEXT:"has time"] to weigh the data before raising rates again.
The Fed last month hiked its interest rate target by a quarter percentage point, to between 3.75% and 4%, as officials penciled in expectations of another increase before year-end. The [USN:SPN45L011 TEXT:"comments"] from officials this week indicated no rate action is likely at the Federal Open Market Committee meeting scheduled for Oct. 27-28.

items.title: Inversores ajustan sus apuestas ante la incertidumbre por las reñidas elecciones en Brasil
items.author: Barbara Nascimento, Vinícius Andrade
items.summary: Los mercados se preparan para grandes fluctuaciones del real, mientras que la negociación de opciones en el mayor fondo cotizado que sigue la evolución de las acciones del país ha experimentado un aug ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Los inversores interesados en operar con las elecciones brasileñas, que están demasiado reñidas para anticipar un resultado, están priorizando los derivados sobre las apuestas directas, después de que el favorito del mercado, Flávio Bolsonaro, recortara distancia con el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Ver más: Elecciones en Brasil: qué se juega el real, los bonos y las acciones entre Lula y Bolsonaro Los mercados se preparan para grandes fluctuaciones del real brasileño, mientras que la negociación de opciones en el mayor fondo cotizado que sigue la evolución de las acciones del país ha experimentado un auge. No se espera que ninguno de los candidatos obtenga los votos suficientes para ganar en la primera vuelta del domingo, pero probablemente servirá para vislumbrar el desempeño de Lula —un izquierdista que busca un cuarto mandato— en una segunda vuelta contra el hijo mayor del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, quien ha experimentado un reciente ascenso en las encuestas, reduciendo la ventaja del actual mandatario. “Prevemos reacciones iniciales del mercado opuestas según el resultado”, declaró Petar Atanasov, codirector de análisis de deuda soberana en Gramercy Funds Management. “Esperamos que el impulso de las reformas fiscales sea significativo bajo el mandato de Bolsonaro y que vaya acompañado de un fuerte optimismo en el mercado”. El mercado de opciones refleja la alta concentración de riesgo en torno a la votación del domingo. La volatilidad implícita semanal del real ha superado el 31%, el nivel más alto desde finales de 2022. La volatilidad a un mes, que abarca ambas rondas de votación, también ha aumentado, pero se mantiene por debajo del 25%. Una ventaja de Lula inferior a dos puntos porcentuales sobre Bolsonaro en la primera vuelta sería positiva para el candidato de derecha, ya que muchos candidatos de terceros partidos probablemente se inclinarían por él en una segunda vuelta, escribieron los estrategas de Citigroup Inc. ( C ), entre ellos Dirk Willer, en una nota. Una diferencia de dos a cuatro puntos seguiría indicando una “contienda reñida” en la segunda vuelta, añadieron. Ver más: EE.UU. y Australia suspenden servicios consulares en Brasil por seguridad antes de las elecciones Si bien Lula ha sido, en ocasiones, más pragmático de lo que algunos inversionistas esperaban, los mercados del país se han quedado rezagados con respecto a sus pares durante su tercer mandato. El Ibovespa ha tenido un desempeño inferior al de los indicadores de acciones emergentes y al índice S&P 500 en este lapso. El real se mantuvo prácticamente sin cambios, quedando por detrás de las principales monedas de mercados emergentes, incluyendo el peso mexicano y el rand sudafricano. Las empresas y las familias están sufriendo las consecuencias de las tasas de interés de dos dígitos, que se han mantenido altas mientras el gobierno se resiste a un ajuste fiscal significativo. Los participantes en el mercado afirman que una victoria de Bolsonaro aumenta las posibilidades de que Brasil frene un déficit presupuestario que se sitúa en más del 9% del producto interior bruto. Aunque aún no ha detallado sus propuestas económicas, el equipo de Bolsonaro ha promocionado planes de reforma administrativa y la venta de activos de propiedad estatal. Los mercados de predicción situaban a Lula como favorito hasta principios de septiembre, pero ahora estiman que las posibilidades de victoria de Bolsonaro rondan el 60%. La mejora de estas probabilidades ha llevado a los operadores a realizar apuestas alcistas sobre Brasil, y bancos como Citigroup o JPMorgan Chase & Co. ( JPM ) recomiendan apostar por opciones que se inclinen por un real más fuerte para aprovechar un posible repunte tras las elecciones. Ver más: A qué hora comienza la votación este domingo por las elecciones de Brasil 2026 “Prevemos que la mayor sorpresa se dará en la primera ronda, con Flávio probablemente superando a Lula”, afirmó Fabricio Taschetto, director de inversiones del fondo de cobertura Ace Capital en São Paulo. “Podríamos ver un movimiento posterior a la votación incluso mayor que el ya reflejado en la volatilidad implícita”, añadió Taschetto, quien ha utilizado opciones para realizar apuestas alcistas en el ETF iShares MSCI Brazil, o EWZ. El interés abierto en las opciones sobre el EWZ se encuentra en un máximo histórico de más de 9 millones de contratos, impulsado principalmente por las opciones de compra, que suelen ganar valor cuando el activo subyacente sube. La demanda de opciones de compra sobre el índice Ibovespa también se ha disparado desde finales de agosto, y fondos de cobertura locales como Ibiuna Investimentos y Verde Asset Management han comunicado a sus clientes que estaban utilizando opciones para posicionarse de cara a un posible repunte. El posicionamiento no es unilateral. Alejandro Cuadrado, director de estrategia global de divisas y Latinoamérica de Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria SA, afirmó que el banco ha observado un mayor interés en las opciones digitales en general. Las empresas y los inversores institucionales se han centrado más en estructuras que generan ganancias si la moneda brasileña se fortalece, mientras que otros han buscado protección contra un real más débil, explicó. Los bonos locales también están ganando popularidad de cara a las elecciones. Inversores como Gramercy, Ninety One y M&G Investment Management afirman que la rentabilidad ofrece suficiente compensación para mantener la inversión hasta las elecciones, a la vez que deja margen para obtener ganancias considerables si la próxima administración implementa reformas económicas. “Las tasas locales ofrecen la asimetría más positiva de cara a las elecciones”, afirmó Christine Reed, gestora de cartera de mercados emergentes en Ninety One. Con las tasas ajustadas a la inflación firmemente en territorio restrictivo, el banco central de Brasil tiene “margen para continuar su ciclo de recortes independientemente de quién resulte elegido”, añadió. Ver más: MercadoLibre enfrenta revisión regulatoria en Brasil por su plan de mercado de medicamentos En M&G, Carlos Carranza, gestor sénior de fondos de deuda de mercados emergentes, mantiene una posición “ligeramente larga” en los mercados locales brasileños, ya que prevé margen para un repunte de la deuda denominada en reales. “Un compromiso creíble y oportuno con la consolidación fiscal podría desencadenar un repunte significativo del mercado, mientras que la continua incertidumbre podría mantener la presión sobre los activos brasileños”, afirmó. “Los rendimientos son lo suficientemente altos como para compensar a los inversores por la incertidumbre fiscal”. --Con la colaboración de Felipe Saturnino y Daniel Carvalho. items.title: Chinese Auto Show Debuts in Argentina as Sales Surge
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: By Leila Miller BUENOS AIRES, Oct 2 (Reuters) – Buenos Aires is hosting its first Chinese auto show on Friday as Argentina’s car market under President Javier Milei has shifted from heavy protectionism to a more open and competitive environment. Chinese brands are flooding the …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
By Leila Miller

BUENOS AIRES, Oct 2 (Reuters) – Buenos Aires is hosting its first Chinese auto show on Friday as Argentina’s car market under President Javier Milei has shifted from heavy protectionism to a more open and competitive environment.

Chinese brands are flooding the market, benefiting from a measure that allows up to 50,000 electric and hybrid vehicles without tariffs in 2026. Chinese brands accounted for 10% of car and light commercial vehicle sales in Argentina in August, up from about 2% late last year.

Since launching in Argentina in late 2025, China’s electric-vehicle maker BYD has become the ninth-best-selling car brand. The company leads electric car sales in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador and Uruguay.

At the auto show, more than 20 Chinese brands, including Geely, Chery, GWM and Dongfeng, were on display. German Molina, a 3D designer who already owns a Chinese car and wants to buy another, looked around with his wife and son.

“If you go out onto the main avenues or neighborhoods, you see a large number of Chinese cars, and it’s not just one brand, but many different ones,” said Molina. “I believe it’s only a matter of time before people start embracing them a bit more.”

An Omoda hybrid system is on display at the first Chinese auto show in Argentina on October 2, 2026, as Chinese automakers expand in the country. REUTERS/Alessia Maccioni

Sebastian Beato, president of Argentina’s auto dealers’ association ACARA, said the “impressive” growth among Chinese brands had pushed the national industry to produce new models, such as the Renault Niagara pick-up truck unveiled in September.

Earlier this week the Argentine government said Japanese automaker Toyota Motor would invest $1.34 billion to develop an EV plant in Argentina.

If Argentina’s auto industry doesn’t transform, “it’s going to have obsolete cars,” Beato said.

Milei Unconcerned

Chinese automakers are steadily expanding across Latin America, selling both traditional vehicles and EVs at a pace that has alarmed some local markets.

Brazil and Mexico have introduced tariffs aimed at slowing the influx and protecting domestic manufacturing jobs. But Milei, a libertarian, has said he is unconcerned by the rapid growth of BYD and dismissed suggestions that it could complicate his close relationship with the U.S. during an interview last month.

“What Argentines buy is the problem of Argentines,” Milei told Bloomberg at the Economic Club of New York.

Tesla in July launched operations in Uruguay, and there are signs the U.S. automaker could soon enter Argentina.

A Haval vehicle is displayed during the first Chinese auto show in Argentina on October 2, 2026. Chinese automakers are expanding in the country as the Argentinian government opens up the market, boosting competition in the automotive sector. REUTERS/Alessia Maccioni

The registration of Tesla Argentina appeared in the country’s official gazette in April, and state energy company YPF said in June it had signed a letter of intent with Tesla to explore energy storage opportunities.

Tesla did not respond to a request for comment.

‘Possibility to Compete’

Car sales in Argentina have fallen 13% so far this year from the same period in 2025, a decline that industry analysts attribute to a market adjustment after last year’s strong growth was fueled by lower trade barriers. High interest rates have also dissuaded consumers from taking out car loans.

Andres Civetta, an economist at consultancy Abeceb, said Argentina’s auto industry should focus on pick-up trucks, where the country has established a strong export position and doesn’t yet face competition from Chinese brands.

Fernando Rodriguez Canedo, executive director of Argentina’s association of car factories, welcomed Milei’s gradual rollback of national export duties and said the industry was also pressing provincial governments to reduce local taxes.

“That would give us the possibility to compete,” Canedo said.

Tennessee execution survivor Christa Pike on ventilator, attorneys say

A picture taken on Dec 4, 2007, shows death-row inmate Christa Pike entering the Knox County Criminal Court in Knoxville, Tennessee, US, obtained by Reuters on Sep 30, 2026. (File photo: J. Miles Cary/ Knoxville News Sentinel/USA Today Network via Reuters)

NASHVILLE: Convicted killer Christa Pike was left gravely ill, unconscious and hospitalised on life support after Tennessee's failed attempt to execute her by lethal injection, her lawyers said on Friday (Oct 2), providing the first detailed account of the injuries she suffered.
Hospital staff were working to save Pike's life and clear the drug pentobarbital from her system, her attorneys said in an emergency motion, which seeks a court order for Tennessee's Department of Correction to preserve evidence from Wednesday night's botched execution.
Pike remained in critical condition, intubated and hooked to a mechanical ventilator to breathe, her lawyers said, after two doses of pentobarbital were administered to her intravenously at the Riverbend Maximum Security Institution in Nashville, the state capital.
The bungled attempt to establish intravenous lines also left both her arms "swollen, burned and blistered", the apparent result of the pentobarbital, a highly alkaline and caustic substance, seeping into the tissues under her skin, the court filing said.
'VEINS HAD BLOWN'

The lawyers accused Correction Department officials of shrugging off prior warnings from Pike's doctors that pre-existing medical conditions — small veins and a blood disorder called thrombocytosis — would make placing IV lines especially difficult.
"At no point did any member of the execution team realise that the IV lines were not correctly placed or that the veins had blown and that the pentobarbital was, in whole or in part, entering Ms. Pike's body," her lawyers said in a filing in the Chancery Court for Tennessee's 20th Judicial District.
It said witnesses to the execution attempt could hear Pike "crying, whimpering and breathing loudly throughout the procedure".
The filing provided the fullest picture yet of the medical consequences of an attempted execution that Tennessee Governor Bill Lee said followed the state's established protocol.
It was the state's second botched execution this year, prompting Lee to halt any further attempts to carry out the death penalty for the rest of 2026. He also ordered an independent review of what went wrong.

Related:

Tennessee death row inmate in hospital after surviving two lethal injections

Pike, 50, was convicted three decades ago of first-degree murder for her role in the torture and killing of a 19-year-old vocational school classmate, Colleen Slemmer, at the University of Tennessee campus in Knoxville in 1995, when Pike was 18.
She had been scheduled to become the first woman executed in Tennessee in more than two centuries, and the only person in the modern era of US capital punishment to be executed in that state for a crime committed by a teenager.
Pike's then-17-year-old boyfriend was tried as an adult and convicted of murder as well, but received a life sentence with eligibility for parole. A third schoolmate who was 18 at the time and acted as a lookout for the two others ended up testifying for the prosecution and received probation.
Lee earlier this week rejected a clemency petition seeking to commute Pike's death penalty to a life prison term without the possibility of parole. The petition argued for leniency, in part, on the basis of her childhood history of severe neglect, sexual abuse that included two rapes, and untreated mental illness.
The clemency petition also cited evidence that Pike's mother drank heavily during pregnancy, contributing to faulty brain development that made it difficult for her to control her impulses.
The US Supreme Court on Wednesday lifted an 11th-hour stay of execution, which was issued earlier in the day by a federal appeals court to give more time to weigh Pike's claim that her childhood trauma was not properly considered in her sentencing.
In their filing on Friday, Pike's lawyers urged the state Chancery Court to order preservation of evidence they said would show that state prison personnel violated her constitutional rights by subjecting her to cruel and unusual punishment.

Source: Reuters/bg

items.author: CNA

Tennessee execution survivor Christa Pike on ventilator, attorneys say

The lawyers accused Correction Department officials of shrugging off prior warnings that pre-existing medical conditions would make placing IV lines especially difficult.

A picture taken on Dec 4, 2007, shows death-row inmate Christa Pike entering the Knox County Criminal Court in Knoxville, Tennessee, US, obtained by Reuters on Sep 30, 2026. (File photo: J. Miles Cary/ Knoxville News Sentinel/USA Today Network via Reuters)

NASHVILLE: Convicted killer Christa Pike was left gravely ill, unconscious and hospitalised on life support after Tennessee's failed attempt to execute her by lethal injection, her lawyers said on Friday (Oct 2), providing the first detailed account of the injuries she suffered.
Hospital staff were working to save Pike's life and clear the drug pentobarbital from her system, her attorneys said in an emergency motion, which seeks a court order for Tennessee's Department of Correction to preserve evidence from Wednesday night's botched execution.
Pike remained in critical condition, intubated and hooked to a mechanical ventilator to breathe, her lawyers said, after two doses of pentobarbital were administered to her intravenously at the Riverbend Maximum Security Institution in Nashville, the state capital.
The bungled attempt to establish intravenous lines also left both her arms "swollen, burned and blistered", the apparent result of the pentobarbital, a highly alkaline and caustic substance, seeping into the tissues under her skin, the court filing said.
'VEINS HAD BLOWN'

The lawyers accused Correction Department officials of shrugging off prior warnings from Pike's doctors that pre-existing medical conditions — small veins and a blood disorder called thrombocytosis — would make placing IV lines especially difficult.
"At no point did any member of the execution team realise that the IV lines were not correctly placed or that the veins had blown and that the pentobarbital was, in whole or in part, entering Ms. Pike's body," her lawyers said in a filing in the Chancery Court for Tennessee's 20th Judicial District.
It said witnesses to the execution attempt could hear Pike "crying, whimpering and breathing loudly throughout the procedure".
The filing provided the fullest picture yet of the medical consequences of an attempted execution that Tennessee Governor Bill Lee said followed the state's established protocol.
It was the state's second botched execution this year, prompting Lee to halt any further attempts to carry out the death penalty for the rest of 2026. He also ordered an independent review of what went wrong.

Related:

Tennessee death row inmate in hospital after surviving two lethal injections

Pike, 50, was convicted three decades ago of first-degree murder for her role in the torture and killing of a 19-year-old vocational school classmate, Colleen Slemmer, at the University of Tennessee campus in Knoxville in 1995, when Pike was 18.
She had been scheduled to become the first woman executed in Tennessee in more than two centuries, and the only person in the modern era of US capital punishment to be executed in that state for a crime committed by a teenager.
Pike's then-17-year-old boyfriend was tried as an adult and convicted of murder as well, but received a life sentence with eligibility for parole. A third schoolmate who was 18 at the time and acted as a lookout for the two others ended up testifying for the prosecution and received probation.
Lee earlier this week rejected a clemency petition seeking to commute Pike's death penalty to a life prison term without the possibility of parole. The petition argued for leniency, in part, on the basis of her childhood history of severe neglect, sexual abuse that included two rapes, and untreated mental illness.
The clemency petition also cited evidence that Pike's mother drank heavily during pregnancy, contributing to faulty brain development that made it difficult for her to control her impulses.
The US Supreme Court on Wednesday lifted an 11th-hour stay of execution, which was issued earlier in the day by a federal appeals court to give more time to weigh Pike's claim that her childhood trauma was not properly considered in her sentencing.
In their filing on Friday, Pike's lawyers urged the state Chancery Court to order preservation of evidence they said would show that state prison personnel violated her constitutional rights by subjecting her to cruel and unusual punishment.

Source: Reuters/bg

items.title: 'Handful' of G20 countries reject US stance on excess industrial capacity
items.author: David Lawder
items.creator: David Lawder
items.summary: A "handful" of G20 trade ministers rejected US calls to curb excess industrial capacity and "non-market" policies, the US Trade Representative's office said on Friday, exposing divisions within the group of major economies.
items.body:
A "handful" of G20 trade ministers rejected US calls to curb excess industrial capacity and "non-market" policies, the US Trade Representative's office said on Friday, exposing divisions within the group of major economies.
The US G20 chair's statement, issued a day after a [USN:L1N45N131 TEXT:"trade meeting in Milwaukee"] ended, also revealed that only two countries — Mexico and Argentina — signed on to a US-led statement calling for more work and cooperation to eliminate goods produced with forced labor from supply chains.
The rejection follows the Trump administration's imposition of tariffs of 10% or 12.5% on goods from 59 countries and the European Union over allegations that they fail to adequately enforce bans on forced labor.
The USTR statement did not name countries that objected to the excess capacity statement. But China had [USN:L1N44T0JC TEXT:"objected"] to a similar G20 statement denouncing forced labor and non-market economic policies that lead to excessive exports at a finance leaders' meeting a month ago in Asheville, North Carolina.
"The draft ministerial statement was supported by all but a handful of members, a few of whom firmly rejected creating this pathway toward cooperative action" on excess capacity, the statement said, adding that this "severely disappointed" the US G20 presidency.
China's excess industrial capacity and industrial subsidies have been key themes of the US-led G20 ministerial meetings so far this year. Beijing has rejected claims that its industrial policies have created excess capacity, and accuses Western countries of using the issue to justify protectionist measures.
The US said that G20 trade ministers were able to reach consensus on denouncing the weaponization of food trade with members agreeing "that trade in food and agricultural products should not be used as a tool for economic or political coercion."

items.title: Tribunal de apelações dos EUA bloqueia lei de Minnesota contra fotos com nudez simulada por IA em processo da xAI
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A xAI de Elon Musk conseguiu nesta sexta-feira que um tribunal federal de apelações dos EUA suspendesse a proibição do Estado de Minnesota — a primeira do país — relativa a imagens falsas de nudez geradas por IA, enquanto a empresa de tecnologia e mídias sociais dá andamento a uma ação judicial alegando que a lei é inconstitucional.
items.body:
A xAI de Elon Musk conseguiu nesta sexta-feira que um tribunal federal de apelações dos EUA suspendesse a proibição do Estado de Minnesota — a primeira do país — relativa a imagens falsas de nudez geradas por IA, enquanto a empresa de tecnologia e mídias sociais dá andamento a uma ação judicial alegando que a lei é inconstitucional.
O Tribunal Federal de Apelações do 8º Circuito com sede em St. Louis, em sua decisão, suspendeu a lei por enquanto, deferindo um pedido de liminar apresentado pela xAI. No mês passado, um juiz de primeira instância havia rejeitado o pedido de Musk para uma ordem que suspendesse a lei.
A lei estadual contra a “nudificação”, que entrou em vigor em 1º de agosto, proíbe operadores de sites, desenvolvedores de software e outros de permitir que usuários criem imagens realistas retratando uma parte íntima do corpo que não apareça na foto original de um indivíduo identificável.
A xAI alega que a medida restringe a liberdade de expressão protegida pela Constituição dos EUA.
Minnesota e a xAI não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário.
O juiz federal Donovan Frank decidiu no mês passado que a xAI não havia demonstrado que sofreria dano irreparável ao contestar a lei e afirmou que a empresa havia esperado tempo demais para solicitar uma medida cautelar.
Em seu recurso, a xAI contestou a conclusão do juiz de que ela teria demorado a entrar com a ação. A empresa também afirmou que sua ferramenta Grok Imagine inclui “proteções rigorosas” contra a criação de imagens de nudez ou sexualizadas de pessoas reais.
A xAI começou a processar usuários que, segundo ela, estão contornando os bloqueadores tecnológicos do Grok para criar imagens de caráter sexual de pessoas sem o consentimento delas.
O Estado de Minnesota havia instado o tribunal de apelação a não bloquear a lei. O Estado afirmou ter adotado a medida este ano para combater a disseminação do que chamou de “uma quantidade impressionante de material de abuso sexual infantil gerado por produtos de IA como o Grok Imagine”.

items.title: Texans' Nico Collins set to return; Joey Porter Jr. may go for Cowboys
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Houston Texans standout receiver Nico Collins was a full practice participant on Friday and is set to play in Sunday's home game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.body:
Houston Texans standout receiver Nico Collins was a full practice participant on Friday and is set to play in Sunday's home game against the Dallas Cowboys.
Collins missed the past two games after hurting his hamstring in practice on Sept. 16. He was limited in practice on Wednesday and Thursday this week.
A two-time Pro Bowl selection, Collins had seven catches for 75 yards and a touchdown in Houston's 36-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills in its season opener on Sept. 13.
Collins, 27, has topped 1,000 receiving yards in each of the past three seasons. He had a career-best 1,297 yards in 2023.
The 2021 third-round draft pick has 296 receptions for 4,422 yards and 25 scores in 67 career games (53 starts), all with the Texans.
As expected, linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) was ruled out for Houston (0-3). Safety M.J. Stewart (knee) didn't practice Friday and also will miss the contest.
Defensive ends Jadeveon Clowney (knee) and Logan Hall (knee), guard Ed Ingram (groin) and linebacker Jake Hansen (calf) are all questionable for the Texans. Houston placed running back British Brooks (hamstring) on injured reserve Friday.
For Dallas (1-2), cornerback Cobie Durant and linebacker DeMarvion Overshown were both ruled out with hamstring injuries. Safety Malik Hooker (forearm) practiced in full Friday and doesn't have an injury designation after missing the previous two games.
The Cowboys are also preparing cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to play Sunday. Dallas acquired him from the Pittsburgh Steelers in a trade on Wednesday.
"I think we've got a really good plan that if he does play, where we'll use him and what that will look like," Dallas coach Brian Schottenheimer told reporters on Friday.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Apple says it will flag AI requests for Mac data after Meta's Muse draws complaints
items.author: Stephen Nellis
items.creator: Stephen Nellis
items.summary: Apple said on Friday that it plans to change its Mac operating system to make it more obvious when AI agents ask to access all of the data on Macs.
items.body:
Apple (AAPL.O) said on Friday that it plans to change its Mac operating system to make it more obvious when AI agents ask to access all of the data on Macs.
Some users have criticized Meta's (META.O) Muse, an AI agent capable of carrying out complex tasks like canceling unused subscriptions or haggling for better prices. These people claimed the agent accessed what users believed to be private messages.
On Apple's iPhones and iPads, no single app can access data inside another app by default, a technique called sandboxing. But Apple's Macs are more flexible, with a "Full Disk Access" option that allows apps such as cloud backup services to access all the data on a machine, with a user's permission.
Apple on Friday said some developers were using the Full Disk Access feature in ways that could put users at risk.
"Going forward, we will introduce additional controls to ensure that users who genuinely wish to grant an app this extraordinary level of access can only do so with very explicit user action," Apple wrote in a post .
"As AI agents become increasingly capable and autonomous, the risks associated with this level of access will grow substantially. We are committed to ensuring users clearly understand these risks before granting such access, so they can make informed decisions about their own data and privacy."
Apple's move comes after Inc magazine technology columnist Jason Aten accused Meta's Muse of reading private messages on his Mac. He said he had not enabled Full Disk Access.
Meta spokesperson Andy Stone pushed back against those claims last week, saying Muse's access to Apple's Messages app is strictly opt-in.
"You have to enable both Full Disk Access and the Messages connector for Muse to be able to read your Messages content," Stone wrote on social media platform X . "It can't read your Messages unless you do this. And it can be revoked at any time."
Apple declined to comment beyond its post. Meta did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

items.title: Swonger Says Trade Barriers Will Hurt Spirits Industry
items.summary: Chris Swonger, President and CEO of the Distilled Spirits Council of the United States, says the US represents 93% of the Canadian spirits industry and warns that restrictions on cross-border trade will hurt the hospitality economy on both sides of the border. Swonger says the spirits industry has thrived with no trade barriers and zero-to-zero tariffs, and says the sector is also facing pressure from GLP-1 medications, younger consumers drinking less and inflationary challenges. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Rep. Landsman: AI Czar Wouldn’t Provide Enough Oversight
items.summary: Rep. Greg Landsman (D-OH) says naming a White House AI czar would not provide the level of oversight needed around AI and data centers. Rep. Landsman says nondisclosure agreements surrounding data-center deals should be banned and says his legislation would require data centers to pay their costs rather than pass them on to individuals. Rep. Landsman says the bill would fine data centers $15 million a day for noncompliance and transfer authority over who pays to the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Rediker: Powell Is a ‘Tempering Influence’ on Fed Board
items.summary: Doug Rediker, Managing Partner at International Capital Strategies and formerly represented the US on the Executive Board of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), says former Fed Chair Jerome Powell’s continued presence on the Board of Governors is a “tempering influence” on current Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. Rediker says he has been reluctant to think the Fed would raise rates because of the proximity to the midterm elections, though he says he is not highly confident in that view. Rediker also says bond markets in the US and France are subject to the influence of “bond vigilantes” and says he would not rule out the 10-year Treasury yield reaching 6%. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Kirkland, Latham top M&A adviser rankings amid 3rd quarter slowdown
items.author: David Thomas
items.creator: David Thomas
items.summary: Law firm Kirkland & Ellis was the lead global M&A legal adviser by deal value in the first nine months of 2026, and Latham & Watkins advised on more deals than any other firm, according to new data released Friday by LSEG.
items.body:
Law firm Kirkland & Ellis was the lead global M&A legal adviser by deal value in the first nine months of 2026, and Latham & Watkins advised on more deals than any other firm, according to new data released Friday by LSEG.
M&A deals announced in the first three quarters reached $3.9 trillion, a 28% increase compared to the same period last year and the "strongest opening period for deal making since 2021," LSEG said in its M&A legal adviser rankings.
But aggregate deal value took a nosedive in the third quarter, dropping 41% compared to the second quarter of 2026, LSEG found.
In the first three quarters combined, Kirkland worked on 565 deals worth $601 billion, followed by Sullivan & Cromwell with 159 deals worth $473 billion, according to LSEG's rankings of advisers on announced transactions by deal value. Latham was top-ranked by number of deals, handling 613 deals worth an overall $457 billion. Goodwin was second, advising on 587 deals worth $232 billion.
Last quarter was the first time since the second quarter of 2025 that quarterly deal value dropped below $1 trillion, LSEG found. The number of mega deals -- transactions worth more than $10 billion -- and the total number of deals [USN:L6N45M0VD TEXT:"both dropped in the third quarter"].
"I don't view it as that surprising we're seeing volatility, that's been the theme the last few years," said Josh Zachariah, who leads Goodwin Procter's M&A group.
Dealmakers faced headwinds in the last quarter that included stock market volatility, rising oil prices and "stubborn" inflation, Zachariah said.
Paul Kukish, who serves as global co-chair of Latham's M&A and private equity practice, said in a statement he expects to see "some continued caution, especially for larger, more transformational deals, but not a uniform pause across the market" in the fourth quarter of 2026. Kukish and Zachariah both said their firms are busy with M&A work.
Spokespersons for Kirkland and Sullivan & Cromwell had no immediate comment.

items.title: Coreia do Norte dispara projétil não identificado em direção ao mar na costa leste, diz governo sul-coreano
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Coreia do Norte disparou um projétil não identificado em direção ao mar, na costa leste do país, informou o Estado-Maior Conjunto da Coreia do Sul em um comunicado.
items.body:
Coreia do Norte disparou um projétil não identificado em direção ao mar, na costa leste do país, informou o Estado-Maior Conjunto da Coreia do Sul em um comunicado.
O lançamento ocorreu depois que Kim Yo Jong, de Pyongyang — irmã influente do líder Kim Jong Un —, divulgou nesta sexta-feira um comunicado rejeitando a exigência de Seul de um pedido de desculpas pelas minas norte-coreanas que feriram gravemente soldados sul-coreanos na Zona Desmilitarizada, uma área fortemente fortificada entre as duas Coreias.
A Coreia do Sul afirmou nesta semana que as minas norte-coreanas causaram a explosão que feriu gravemente dois soldados sul-coreanos durante uma missão de reconhecimento dentro da fronteira de 4 km de largura que se estende pela Península Coreana.
A Coreia do Norte intensificou drasticamente sua hostilidade contra o Sul nos últimos anos, renegando a unificação como objetivo nacional e chamando a Coreia do Sul de seu “principal inimigo”.

items.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile toward sea, South Korea and Japan say
items.author: Heejin Kim
items.creator: Heejin Kim
items.summary: North Korea fired a ballistic missile toward the sea off its east coast on Saturday, South Korea and Japan said.
items.body:
North Korea fired a ballistic missile toward the sea off its east coast on Saturday, South Korea and Japan said.
The missile was launched from the Wonsan area at around 6.30 a.m. on Saturday (2130 GMT, Friday), the South Korean military said in a statement. It did not elaborate on how far the missile flew.
Japan's coast guard, in an emailed statement citing the Japanese defence ministry, said the object may have been a ballistic missile and appeared to have come down, warning ships to take precautions.
South Korea's military said it has raised its monitoring of any further missile tests and will share intelligence with the US and Japan .
The South Korean presidential office's national security council convened an emergency meeting on Saturday to assess the situation after the missile launch, the office said in a statement.
The launch came after Pyongyang's Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of leader Kim Jong Un, issued a [USN:L1N45O07Z TEXT:"statement"] on Friday that dismissed Seoul's demand for an apology for what it said were North Korean mines that seriously wounded South Korean soldiers in the Demilitarised Zone, a heavily fortified area between the two Koreas.
South Korea said this week that North Korean mines caused the blast that seriously injured two South Korean soldiers on a reconnaissance mission inside the 4-km-wide (2.5-mile) border that stretches across the Korean Peninsula.
North Korea has sharply ramped up hostility against the South in recent years, disavowing unification as a national goal and calling South Korea its "primary foe".
items.raw_description: North Korea fired a ballistic missile toward the sea off its east coast on Saturday, South Korea and Japan said.

items.title: HRW pide a EE.UU y Ecuador revelar base legal de ataques contra barcos en el Pacífico
items.author: Carlos Cuevas
items.summary: Human Rights Watch cuestiona las operaciones estadounidenses contra ocho embarcaciones ecuatorianas. Además, pide a Washington y a Quito revelar el marco jurídico que sustentó las interceptaciones.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Human Rights Watch (HRW) denunció este viernes que fuerzas estadounidenses han destruido ocho buques ecuatorianos entre el 28 de agosto y el 16 de septiembre, argumentando presuntos vínculos con estructuras criminales, pero sin pruebas públicas que lo demuestren y sin revelar la base jurídica de las operaciones. La organización defensora de los derechos humanos expuso que de los 160 tripulantes, 90 enfrentan investigaciones penales en Ecuador, mientras que jueces ecuatorianos dictaminaron que la detención de 56 fue ilegal y 14 no fueron procesados. Ver más: Corte de Ecuador concede extradición a EE.UU. de investigados por el crimen de Villavicencio El Comando Sur de los Estados Unidos ha expuesto que las embarcaciones sirven como “estaciones flotantes de reabastecimiento de combustible en apoyo de operaciones ilícitas de narcotráfico en aguas internacionales del Pacífico Oriental”. Haciendo referencia a una de ellas en específico, en un comunicado del 2 de septiembre del Comando Sur, sostuvo que gracias a información de inteligencia se confirmó que una embarcación interceptada “operaba en apoyo de la violenta organización narcoterrorista Los Choneros”. Los Choneros son uno de cuatro grupos criminales ecuatorianos designados por la administración del presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, como organizaciones terroristas extranjeras. Y su otrora líder, alias Fito, fue extraditado a territorio norteamericano el 20 de julio de 2025, luego de haber sido arrestado en Manta, Ecuador. En ese contexto, la directora para las Américas de HRW, Juanita Goebertus, declaró: “Interceptar el tráfico de combustible en el mar puede ser un paso importante para detener a los grupos criminales, pero eso no autoriza a las fuerzas de seguridad a arrestar a personas sin pruebas, destruir sus embarcaciones ni abusar de ellas”. Además, solicitó a Ecuador y Estados Unidos publicar el marco jurídico de las operaciones, así como los criterios utilizados para interceptar embarcaciones. Y planteó que se deberían “establecer salvaguardias sólidas para prevenir futuros abusos” de las autoridades. HRW entrevistó a 27 personas, incluyendo capitales, tripulantes, familiares de los detenidos y abogados que representan a los detenidos. Sumado a ello, recopiló fotografías y videos de las interceptaciones a las embarcaciones. La organización, sin embargo, no pudo “determinar si alguno de los buques funcionaba como estación de repostaje ilegal”. Pese a que las autoridades estadounidenses alegaron que sí, los miembros de la tripulación entrevistados negaron su participación”. HRW solicitó comentarios a la Fiscalía General de Ecuador y al Comando Sur de Estados Unidos sobre sus hallazgos, pero no ha recibido respuesta. Ver más: EE.UU. cancela visas a jueces, fiscales y funcionarios de Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador y Perú “Ninguno de los gobiernos ha divulgado públicamente pruebas que respalden las acusaciones”, agregó la organización. “La destrucción de los buques podría haber eliminado pruebas que hubieran ayudado a esclarecer lo sucedido”. El capitán y los tripulantes de la embarcación Los Tres Hermanos , que fue interceptada el 28 de agosto, expusieron que las fuerzas armadas estadounidenses les ordenaron tumbarse boca abajo y los sujetaron con bridas de plástico sin darles ninguna explicación. Luego, los llevaron al buque USS San Antonio, de Estados Unidos. Allí les habrían reemplazado las ataduras de plástico con esposas metálicas ajustadas, les cubrieron los ojos y los oídos. Además, los interrogaron a algunos sobre sus supuestos vínculos con el crimen organizado. “Tras unas siete horas, las fuerzas estadounidenses los embarcaron en las cuatro lanchas de apoyo del Los Tres Hermanos , les ordenaron abandonar la embarcación principal y destruyeron el buque. Ninguno fue detenido al llegar a la costa”, reseñó HRW. La organización incluso citó el testimonio del capitán de Los Tres Hermanos : “Pregunté qué pruebas habían encontrado, qué procedimiento estaban siguiendo y si debía llevar la lancha a Jaramijó o a Manta. Uno de los militares estadounidenses me preguntó: ‘¿Qué prefiere, la muerte o la cárcel?’. Le respondí: ‘Ninguna de las dos’. Entonces me dijo que no volviera a la lancha y nos ordenó ir a Manta en nuestras lanchas de apoyo”.

items.title: Colombia canjea deuda interna por 19,8 billones de pesos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Ministerio de Hacienda de Colombia informó el viernes que canjeó títulos de deuda pública interna por 19,8 billones de pesos (5.985 millones de dólares), en busca de disminuir la presión de pagos previstos para este y el próximo año.
items.body:
El Ministerio de Hacienda de Colombia informó el viernes que canjeó títulos de deuda pública interna por 19,8 billones de pesos (5.985 millones de dólares), en busca de disminuir la presión de pagos previstos para este y el próximo año.
Se trata del primero de tres canjes de deuda pública local que el Gobierno planea realizar antes de finalizar el año.
En la operación, el Ministerio de Hacienda recogió títulos de deuda pública interna TES con vencimiento entre 2026 y 2027, a cambio de los cuales entregó papeles con plazo entre 2027 y 2062, precisó el comunicado.
Los TES son la segunda fuente de financiación interna del gasto público, después del recaudo de impuestos.
El intercambio permitió reducir las amortizaciones en 2,4 billones de pesos este año y en 17,4 billones en 2027.
"Esta operación busca gestionar proactivamente el riesgo de refinanciamiento, optimizar el manejo de la liquidez y dejar al país mejor posicionado para enfrentar los retos en materia fiscal y presupuestal en 2027", dijo el ministro de Hacienda, Miguel Gómez, citado en el comunicado.
Con la operación, la vida media de la deuda interna representada en TES se incrementó en 0,2 años, al pasar de 9,97 a 10,17 años.
El Gobierno anunció en agosto cambios en el presupuesto de gastos para este y el próximo año que mostraron un escenario peor de lo esperado por el mercado, en el que se elevó la proyección de déficit fiscal para este año a un 7,2% del PIB desde una previa de 5,3% y para 2027 se disparó hasta 9,4% del PIB frente a una de 4,5% esperada anteriormente.
Según las nuevas cifras, el Gobierno aumentará su endeudamiento en 35 billones de pesos (10.581 millones de dólares) este año.
"Invitamos a todos inversionistas a ser parte de la segunda ventana de intercambio que tendrá lugar el próximo 22 de octubre de 2026 y de la tercera ventana el próximo 19 de noviembre de 2026", afirmó Gómez.
(1 dólar = 3.307,73 pesos)

items.title: Christa Pike, sobrevivente de execução no Tennessee, respira por aparelho, dizem advogados
items.author: Maria Cardona
items.creator: Maria Cardona
items.summary: A assassina condenada Christa Pike está inconsciente, intubada e recebendo assistência respiratória por meio de um aparelho após a tentativa fracassada do Tennessee de executá-la, informaram seus advogados nesta sexta-feira, fornecendo o primeiro relato detalhado da gravidade de seu estado após a injeção letal.
items.body:
A assassina condenada Christa Pike está inconsciente, intubada e recebendo assistência respiratória por meio de um aparelho após a tentativa fracassada do Tennessee de executá-la, informaram seus advogados nesta sexta-feira, fornecendo o primeiro relato detalhado da gravidade de seu estado após a injeção letal.
A equipe do hospital trabalha para salvar a vida de Pike e eliminar o pentobarbital, a droga letal, de seu organismo, afirmaram seus advogados em um pedido judicial de emergência solicitando uma ordem que exija que o Departamento Penitenciário do Tennessee preserve as provas da execução malsucedida da noite de quarta-feira.
Pike continua em estado crítico, disseram seus advogados, dois dias após o Tennessee administrar duas doses de pentobarbital, sem conseguir matá-la. Ela sofreu lesões significativas nos dois braços, acrescentaram.
“Em nenhum momento algum membro da equipe de execução percebeu que as linhas de infusão não estavam corretamente colocadas, que as veias haviam rompido e que o pentobarbital estava, no todo ou em parte, entrando no corpo da Sra. Pike”, afirmaram os advogados de Pike em um pedido apresentado ao Tribunal de Chancelaria do 20º Distrito Judicial do Estado do Tennessee.
O documento apresenta o quadro mais completo até o momento das consequências médicas de uma tentativa de execução que, segundo o governador do Tennessee, Bill Lee, seguiu o protocolo estabelecido pelo Estado. Foi a segunda execução malsucedida do Estado neste ano. Lee suspendeu todas as outras execuções estaduais até o final de 2026 e ordenou uma investigação independente sobre o ocorrido.
Os advogados de Pike afirmaram que as dificuldades da equipe de execução em administrar o medicamento estavam relacionadas ao acesso intravenoso, questão sobre a qual haviam alertado o estado e os tribunais antes da execução.
Pike, de 50 anos, foi condenada pelo assassinato de sua colega de classe Colleen Slemmer, de 19 anos, em 1995, quando Pike tinha 18 anos. Ela iria se tornar a primeira mulher executada no Tennessee em mais de dois séculos.

items.title: 北朝鮮が弾道ミサイル、日本ＥＥＺ外に落下　韓国は追加発射を警戒
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ソウル／東京　３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ソウル／東京　３日　ロイター］ - 日韓の防衛当局は３日、北朝鮮が東岸沖へ弾道ミサイルを発射したと発表した。日本の防衛省は、日本の排他的経済水域（ＥＥＺ）外へ落下したと推定している。北朝鮮が弾道ミサイルを発射するのは９月２０日以来。

韓国は国家安全保障会議を招集。同国軍は追加の発射に警戒を強めている。

韓国軍の合同参謀本部によると、北朝鮮は午前６時３０分ごろに東部の元山付近から弾道ミサイルを発射した。日本の防衛省は飛行距離６８０キロ程度、最高高度９０キロ程度と分析。韓国軍は７００キロ以上飛行したと分析している。日本政府は北朝鮮に厳重に抗議した。

韓国と北朝鮮は、非武装地帯（ＤＭＺ）で発生した地雷の爆発を巡って非難の応酬を続けている。韓国は、北朝鮮の地雷で自国の兵士が重傷を負ったと主張。北朝鮮の金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記の妹、金与正党総務部長は２日、韓国側の非難を「根拠がない」として一蹴し、韓国側の謝罪要求も退けた。

items.title: Dodgers not talking 3-peat yet as Braves enter NLDS with confidence
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: LOS ANGELES -- The potential road to history for the Los Angeles Dodgers begins with a reunion as the National League Division Series starts Saturday afternoon with a visit from the Atlanta Braves.
items.body:
LOS ANGELES -- The potential road to history for the Los Angeles Dodgers begins with a reunion as the National League Division Series starts Saturday afternoon with a visit from the Atlanta Braves.
Freddie Freeman has been a major postseason contributor during the Dodgers' consecutive World Series titles, and the veteran will be in the heart of the order again in a matchup against his former team.
Freeman also was invaluable in the 2021 World Series when the Braves won their most recent title. Freeman joined the Dodgers as a free agent in 2022 after Atlanta moved on to Matt Olson as their first baseman.
While Freeman has won three rings in five seasons, the Dodgers are trying to become the first National League club to win championships in three consecutive years. Only two American League franchises have ever done it: the New York Yankees and Oakland Athletics.
The Yankees were the last to accomplish the feat when they won championships in 1998, 1999 and 2000.
"We don't need to be adding any extra pressure onto ourselves," Dodgers third baseman Max Muncy said. "We've been saying that for a long time. When you talk about three-peating, you're putting that extra pressure on it that doesn't need to be there. Winning a World Series is already hard enough as it is."
After returning from a biceps injury during the final week of the regular season, Shohei Ohtani will be back atop the Los Angeles order when the club's postseason run begins.
Left-hander Tarik Skubal was named the Dodgers' Game 1 starter over right-hander Yoshinobu Yamamoto. Skubal arrived just before the trade deadline in a deal with the Detroit Tigers and went 5-2 with a 2.61 ERA in 10 starts for his new club.
Skubal is 0-1 with a 4.91 ERA in two career starts against Atlanta, including an outing in April when he gave up two runs over seven innings in a no-decision.
The Braves opened their postseason by getting past the Philadelphia Phillies in the wild-card round. Atlanta won a winner-take-all Game 3 on Thursday behind a three-run home run from Michael Harris II and a dominating day on the mound. Six pitchers kept Philadelphia in check, including staff ace Chris Sale, who recorded the final four outs.
The Braves face the Dodgers after going 5-1 against them in the regular season, including a three-game home sweep in late August.
"Everyone knows the Dodgers have a juggernaut, but we played well against them this year," Atlanta manager Walt Weiss said. "I know that doesn't carry a whole lot of stock. Once the playoffs begin, everybody starts at zero. The Dodgers are healthier now than they were when we saw them."
Weiss has yet to name his Game 1 starter, with a left-handed opener a possibility to line up against early left-handed bats like Ohtani and Freeman.
The Braves will continue to be without a pair of starters in right-hander Bryce Elder (knee) and left-hander Martin Perez (back).
Like Freeman before him, Olson has emerged as a Braves leader, along with Ronald Acuna Jr. Olson hit a team-best 41 home runs in the regular season and added another in the wild-card round. Harris hit 26 home runs in the regular season and Acuna added 20 homers and 21 steals.
"I think it's just kind of going out there and playing our game and knowing that ... we can compete with them and beat them," said Braves catcher Drake Baldwin, an All-Star and 2025 NL Rookie of the Year who contributed 25 home runs.
--Doug Padilla, Field Level Media

items.title: US FDA extends review of Novo Nordisk's hemophilia drug over facility issues
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US FDA has extended its review of Novo Nordisk's experimental hemophilia A drug due to ongoing remediation work at a manufacturing facility, the Danish drugmaker said on Friday.
items.body:
The US FDA has extended its review of Novo Nordisk's (NOVOb.CO) experimental hemophilia A drug due to ongoing remediation work at a manufacturing facility, the Danish drugmaker said on Friday.
Here are some details:
The company was seeking the US Food and Drug Administration's approval for denecimig to treat adults and children with hemophilia A, with or without inhibitors, a rare condition that prevents the blood from clotting properly.
Novo had submitted the application for denecimig in September 2025 and was expecting an FDA decision in the third quarter of 2026.
While the regulator has not yet set a new timeline for its decision, Novo said the FDA did not raise any concerns regarding the safety or effectiveness data from the drug's clinical trials.
The company said the manufacturing site issues do not impact any of its other medicines currently on the market.
"Novo is already in the process of addressing the FDA's requests as efficiently as possible and continuing to work closely with the agency," CEO Mike Doustdar said in a statement.
The company said it still aims to launch denecimig in the US in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approval.
The delay would not affect its 2026 financial forecast, Novo said.

items.title: Pam Bondi’s Secret DOJ Email Address Revealed
items.summary:
A FOIA request has uncovered another little-known feature of life at the top of the Justice Department: attorneys general have used alternate email addresses to conduct government business for over a decade. This time around, Bloomberg News Senior Investigative Reporter Jason Leopold obtained the alias used by former Attorney General Pam Bondi.

The discovery raises broader questions about government transparency and access to public records. Leopold explains how alternate email addresses can make FOIA searches more difficult when requesters don’t know which accounts officials used to conduct government business -- and how revealing those aliases can help journalists locate records that might otherwise be missed. He speaks with Bloomberg Businessweek Daily hosts Carol Massar and Alexis Christoforous. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Victoria Beckham apresenta vestidos transparentes e ternos oversized para a primavera/verão 2027
items.author: Helen Reid
items.creator: Helen Reid
items.summary: Victoria Beckham apresentou vestidos de caimento justo, calças amplas e bolsas grandes em seu desfile de primavera/verão 2027 na Semana de Moda de Paris, nesta sexta-feira.
items.body:
Victoria Beckham apresentou vestidos de caimento justo, calças amplas e bolsas grandes em seu desfile de primavera/verão 2027 na Semana de Moda de Paris, nesta sexta-feira.
As modelos usaram ternos oversized em tons de verde e azul, com ombros largos e acolchoados, combinados com calças fluidas que caíam sobre os saltos. Parkas curtas, marcadas na cintura, foram usadas sobre vestidos transparentes com fendas laterais e barras adornadas com pompons. Bolsas gigantes eram carregadas debaixo do braço.
O negócio de moda e beleza de Victoria Beckham registrou um lucro operacional de 7,3 milhões de libras (US$9,66 milhões) em 2025, tornando-se lucrativo pela primeira vez desde sua fundação, em 2008. A receita da marca nas áreas de moda, artigos de couro, maquiagem e perfumes cresceu 15%, chegando a 129,8 milhões de libras. A marca possui uma loja principal em Londres e inaugurou sua primeira loja em Nova York no mês passado.
Na Conciergerie, uma antiga prisão onde Maria Antonieta ficou detida, as modelos desfilaram diante de fileiras de convidados à luz de velas, incluindo Eva Longoria, David Beckham e os filhos do casal Romeo, Cruz e Harper.
O filho mais velho dos Beckhams, Brooklyn, estava ausente. Ele também está na Semana de Moda de Paris, tendo sido visto na primeira fila do desfile da Balenciaga, na quinta-feira, com sua esposa, Nicola Peltz. Brooklyn tornou públicas, em janeiro, acusações sobre o que chamou de comportamento "controlador" de seus pais, revelando pela primeira vez uma disputa familiar.
A Semana de Moda de Paris vai até terça-feira, com desfiles de moda feminina de gigantes do setor, como Hermès, Chanel e Louis Vuitton, ainda a acontecer.
